Web Developer & Digital Product Manager

Delivering accessible, user first digital applications through development, strategy and UX/UI design.

👋🏾 Hi, I'm Ollie.

I am a web developer and digital product specialist with over 15 years of experience building accessible, user-focused websites. My work sits at the intersection of software development, UX, and digital strategy, with a strong focus on clarity, performance, and long-term maintainability.

I’ve led frontend teams, collaborated closely with designers and stakeholders, and delivered robust digital platforms across the arts, public, and cultural sectors. From custom WordPress builds and system integrations to API-driven services, I focus on making complex systems simple and reliable.

Alongside hands-on development, I studied Product Management at King’s College London, graduating with distinction—strengthening my approach to digital strategy, prioritisation, and delivery.
